title: exohebea angusta
intro: Exohebea angusta, commonly known as the forest mint, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include the relief of fever, cough, and other respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Exohebea angusta include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, an antipyretic, and an expectorant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Exohebea angusta include iridoid glycosides and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
